mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (user_id, expert_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{expertId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO chat (room_id, sender_id, message, created_at, role) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{message}, NOW(), #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id AS userId, r.expert_id AS expertId, c.sender_id AS senderId, c.role FROM chat_room r JOIN chat c ON r.room_id = c.room_id WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY c.created_at desc LIMIT 1
